H.text_or_description: 3 Days of DRESS Deals FINAL DAY!

clean.rationale_short: The headline '3 Days of DRESS Deals FINAL DAY!' is prominent and sets the urgency. The product (models in dresses) is visually central. The call-to-action 'SHOP NOW' is clearly placed at the bottom for easy action. The hierarchy is logical: message → product → action.
